title: 3 kingfishers, 3 clues

scenes.headline: Small, blue on top, orange below
scenes.body: Long dark bill; often just a turquoise flash low over the water.

scenes.headline: Black and white, and it hovers
scenes.body: Often hovers over water to look for fish before diving.

scenes.headline: Huge red bill, brown wings
scenes.body: A big orange kingfisher of coastal mangroves, such as the Sundarbans.

scenes.headline: Save this rule
scenes.body: Blue + orange = common. Black + white + hovering = pied. Red bill in mangroves = brown-winged.

caption:
Not every kingfisher is the blue one.

The brown-winged kingfisher lives only along the coasts of the Bay of Bengal and is listed Near Threatened because mangroves are being lost.

Source: eBird (Cornell Lab); BirdLife International. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Grid hook then one clue per species, ending on a save-able rule. Mixes video and photo; all three species occur in India.
